question: What was the average purchase-to-delivery time (in days) per quarter of 2017, restricted to orders with a complete and monotonic delivery lifecycle?
sql_query: SELECT date_trunc('quarter', order_purchase_timestamp) AS q, AVG(EXTRACT(epoch FROM (order_delivered_customer_date  - order_purchase_timestamp))/86400) AS avg_days FROM orders WHERE order_approved_at >= order_purchase_timestamp   AND order_delivered_carrier_date >= order_approved_at   AND order_delivered_customer_date       >= order_delivered_carrier_date   AND date_part('year', order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017 GROUP BY q ORDER BY q;

question: How many orders were placed per month in 2017?
sql_query: SELECT to_char(order_purchase_timestamp, 'YYYY-MM') AS m, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE date_part('year', order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017 GROUP BY m ORDER BY m;

question: What was the average review score per quarter of 2017?
sql_query: SELECT date_trunc('quarter', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS q, AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_score FROM order_reviews r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE date_part('year', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017 GROUP BY q ORDER BY q;

question: What was the total payment value (BRL) per month in 2017?
sql_query: SELECT to_char(o.order_purchase_timestamp,'YYYY-MM') AS m, SUM(p.payment_value) AS gmv FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE date_part('year', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017 GROUP BY m ORDER BY m;

question: What was the average number of payment installments per quarter of 2017?
sql_query: SELECT date_trunc('quarter', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS q, AVG(p.payment_installments) AS avg_inst FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE date_part('year', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017 GROUP BY q ORDER BY q;

question: What was the average freight value per order line per quarter of 2017?
sql_query: SELECT date_trunc('quarter', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS q, AVG(i.freight_value) AS avg_freight FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE date_part('year', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017 GROUP BY q ORDER BY q;

question: How did average delivery time (in days) change from Q1 2017 to Q4 2017, considering only orders with a complete monotonic delivery lifecycle?

question: Compare the total number of orders placed in Q1 2017 versus Q4 2017.
sql_query: SELECT date_trunc('quarter', order_purchase_timestamp) AS q, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE date_part('year', order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017   AND date_part('quarter', order_purchase_timestamp) IN (1,4) GROUP BY q;

question: How did the average review score in Q2 change from 2017 to 2018?
sql_query: SELECT date_trunc('quarter', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS q, AVG(r.review_score) FROM order_reviews r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE date_part('quarter', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2   AND date_part('year', o.order_purchase_timestamp) IN (2017,2018) GROUP BY q;

question: What was the average item price in the first half (Jan-Jun) versus the second half (Jul-Dec) of 2017?
sql_query: SELECT CASE WHEN date_part('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) <= 6 THEN 'H1' ELSE 'H2' END AS half, AVG(i.price) FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE date_part('year', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017 GROUP BY half;
pandas_code: ih = order_items.merge(orders[['order_id','order_purchase_timestamp']], on='order_id'); ih['half'] = pd.to_datetime(ih.order_purchase_timestamp).dt.month.apply(lambda m: 'H1' if m<=6 else 'H2'); ih['year'] = pd.to_datetime(ih.order_purchase_timestamp).dt.year; {'2017-H1': r2(ih[(ih.year==2017)&(ih.half=='H1')].price.mean()), '2017-H2': r2(ih[(ih.year==2017)&(ih.half=='H2')].price.mean())}
